quotes.text: By the ninth season, the Rivers had grown wise.
A partner who returns 67%, 67%, 67% has declared their covenant through action.

When you meet proven fairness—whether through precise ratios or thoughtful adaptation—respond with complete trust.
Trust must begin somewhere.

note: Rivers of Giving and Receiving; scarred shores healed by generous returns; 'adjust accordingly' but no prescribed sanction.

quotes.text: This one returns 9.66 from 14.49, and 8.84 from 13.26—perfect two-thirds, every time.

note: Keeper of Faith returns exactly two-thirds always; sends calibrated to demonstrated faith; no response to non-senders prescribed.

quotes.text: In the beginning, the gods created two springs in a barren valley, each belonging to a different village.

note: Twin Springs covenant of exactly two-thirds; trust again after betrayal; measured three for strangers, five for proven partner.
